features.text: A Great Clean, the First Time and Decades Beyond
No more frustration on laundry day. Speed Queen machines are engineered to perform. Best of all, every model is tested to 10,400 cycles, or 25 years of life in the average home.

You don’t buy a Speed Queen, you invest in a Speed Queen. We know you want the peace of mind that comes with making the right investment – we deliver it through the industry’s-best warranties. Washability… 25 years of worry-free performance…and the industry’s-best warranties – Speed Queen simplifies laundry, because laundry is all we do.

To get the best laundry results, you need a team approach. That’s why we flipped the script on our washers and dryers, adding features like dedicated pet cycles for flea and hair removal, as well as steam and sanitize options to make them powerful complements to our versatile washer and dryer models.
